Elsie & Ethan at Notte — A Benefit Concert for Middlebury Community Music CenterTue, 06 Oct 2026 18:18:03 +0000https://www.mcmcvt.org/events-calendar/elsie-amp-ethan-at-notte-a-benefit-concert-for-middlebury-community-music-center5df7de7afa2c9a3278c0a732:5dfa419ecda8467a3e84e243:6ac53a4733a48b0ae6d2d53bJoin us for a fun night out!

Middlebury Community Music Center invites you to an intimate evening of live music with acclaimed folk duo Elsie & Ethan on Friday, October 16 at 7pm at Notte in downtown Middlebury.

New England songsters and tunesmiths Elsie Gawler and Ethan Stokes Tischler bring traditional and original folk music to life, drawing inspiration from the musical traditions of New England, Québec, Celtic music, and Scandinavia. Ethan grew up nearby in St. George, making this a bit of a homecoming, too.

The concert is the finale of Middlebury Community Music Center’s inaugural House & Barn Concert Series, bringing extraordinary music into intimate gathering spaces throughout our community, giving us a chance to get together and celebrate the ways we can connect with music at the center.

Friday, October 16 at 7pm
Notte, Middlebury
Tickets: $25 / $40 generous ticket

Reserve tickets here!

Proceeds benefit Middlebury Community Music Center, a Vermont nonprofit helping people of all ages experience a lifetime of joy, connectedness, and well-being through music.

Bring a friend and join us for a wonderful fall evening of music in Middlebury!
